tools.name: extract_url
tools.description: Fetch a public web page (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown plus fixed-schema JSON: article metadata, product/price, tables. Free 20 calls/day per IP; pass 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for prepaid credits.

tools.name: page_markdown
tools.description: Fetch a public web page (robots.txt respected) and return clean Markdown only. Cheaper than extract_url (0.4 credit). Free 20 calls/day per IP; pass 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for prepaid credits.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "extract_url" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
